routeChanges: Player progress uses continuous projection along the circuit, including signed travel through the start/finish seam. Dense AI navigation points remain authored as before. Invalid rejoins advance the attempt without granting valid-lap timing.
unchanged: Scenes, car handling, AI configuration, catalog, upgrade prices and saved progression were not edited by this change.
testMethod: Real RCCP reverse input, braking to a stop and natural AI-driven player laps through the production GamePlayManager. No player transports, seeded velocities or scripted lap completion.
earlierAcceptanceNotes: Two preliminary reverse-stop probes used unsuitable input assumptions, including a handbrake absent from Formula axles; service-brake acceptance passed. One earlier autonomous lap was invalid; subsequent instrumented acceptance runs completed valid laps on both circuits without route invalidations. Earlier attempts preserved under /tmp/formula-route-*-attempt.json.
